# skill_rule_tables

A normative rule of this project is a **row of a table**, not a paragraph. The row carries the name the rule is cited by, what it requires and where it holds — so a crawler's finding can say which rule an object departs from, and a reader can disagree with the rule rather than with the module that read it.

## Naming

- `RULE-TABLES-ID-GRAMMAR`
  - Description: A `rule_id` names its owner first, then its subject, and reads without a lookup.
  - Scope: `module_skills/skills_sheet.xlsx`, `AGENTS.md`, `module_skills/sheet.py`
  - Expected: The owning document's stem without `skill_`, uppercased with `-` for `_`, then the subject and the rule in uppercase kebab-case — the register's rules `GLOSSARY-…`; `module_skills/sheet.py` refuses a `rule_id` without its document's prefix.
  - Exception: The contract's rows, kept by hand in `AGENTS.md`, numbered `D01` onward and carrying no `rule_id`.
- `RULE-TABLES-ID-NOT-A-NUMBER`
  - Description: A number is not an identifier: an identifier says what it is about.
  - Scope: `module_skills/skills_sheet.xlsx`, `AGENTS.md`
  - Expected: A semantic identifier at every place a rule is cited by a finding.
  - Exception: A historical number standing in prose as a reference, and the numbers `D01` onward of the contract's own rows in `AGENTS.md` — never the name a finding names.
- `RULE-TABLES-ID-STABLE`
  - Description: An identifier outlives the wording of its description and the choice of its type.
  - Scope: `module_skills/skills_sheet.xlsx`, `AGENTS.md`
  - Expected: The same `rule_id` before and after an edit that leaves the rule's meaning alone.
  - Exception: A rule whose meaning genuinely changes is a different rule and takes a different identifier.

## Conformities

- `RULE-TABLES-FIRST-HEADER-CELL`
  - Description: A table is read as rules exactly when its header is the sheet's rule header.
  - Scope: `module_skills/skills_sheet.xlsx`, `module_skills/sheet.py`
  - Expected: The header is `skill_path`, `rule_type_id`, `rule_id`, `description`, `scope`, `expected_form`, `exception`, and no tab name decides it instead.
  - Exception: none
- `RULE-TABLES-CORE-COLUMNS`
  - Description: Every rule row carries the seven columns of the sheet's rule header.
  - Scope: `module_skills/skills_sheet.xlsx`, `module_skills/sheet.py`
  - Expected: `skill_path`, `rule_type_id`, `rule_id`, `description`, `scope`, `expected_form`, `exception` present and filled, `none` where a rule has no exception; `module_skills/sheet.py` refuses an empty cell.
  - Exception: none
- `RULE-TABLES-ID-GLOBALLY-UNIQUE`
  - Description: One `rule_id` names one rule across the whole workbook.
  - Scope: `module_skills/skills_sheet.xlsx`, `module_skills/sheet.py`
  - Expected: Each `rule_id` written once; the reader, `module_skills/sheet.py`, refuses a second and names both — `make skills-sync`, `make skills-configurables` and `make skills-crawl` end on it.
  - Exception: none
- `RULE-TABLES-CLOSED-TYPE-VOCABULARY`
  - Description: A rule's `rule_type_id` is one of the closed list, never a word minted at the row.
  - Scope: `module_skills/skills_sheet.xlsx`, `module_skills/sheet.py`
  - Expected: `rule_type_id` holds a value the sheet's `rule_type_id` list writes, and a generated document takes its sections in that list's order.
  - Exception: none
- `RULE-TABLES-RULE-GOVERNS-DATA`
  - Description: A register of names, a grammar or a register of copies stays a table of data, governed by one rule.
  - Scope: `AGENTS.md`, `module_skills/skills_sheet.xlsx`
  - Expected: One `rule_id` whose `scope` names the audited files that must obey the table and whose `expected_form` says what the table decides, its `skill_path` and the tab holding it saying where it is written; the data table keeps its own header.
  - Exception: The contract's rows, kept by hand in `AGENTS.md`, carry no `sheet_tab` and no `skill_path`.
- `RULE-TABLES-A-RULE-IS-CITED-BY-ITS-ID`
  - Description: A rule is cited by its `rule_id`, because a generated document has no numbered or titled section to cite.
  - Scope: `**/*.md`, `**/*.py`, `**/*.js`, `Makefile`, `docker-compose.yml`
  - Expected: A rule named by its `rule_id` wherever a hand-written document, a comment or a docstring cites it, and a generated document cited whole by its path; no `§` into a generated document.
  - Exception: A row of the contract, cited by its number in `AGENTS.md`.
